title: Budgets
intro: Every budget line is read straight from the budget ledger, so it matches to the satang. Select any amount, of a line, a department or the total, to see what makes it up.

year.label: Fiscal year shown
year.notFound: That fiscal year was not found. Show the current one or choose a fiscal year from the list.

low.title: {count, plural, one {# budget line} other {# budget lines}} running low
low.hint: These lines have less than {pct}% of their planned amount left. Open the documents using them to decide whether to add budget or hold new requests.

legend.title: What the amounts mean
legend.planned: Planned: everything imported for the fiscal year (before VAT)
legend.available: Available: what new requests can still use
legend.reserved: Reserved: requests sent but not yet on a purchase order
legend.committed: Committed: approved purchase orders waiting for their invoices
legend.shares: Used = (committed + actual) ÷ planned · Held = (reserved + committed + actual) ÷ planned

table.caption: Budgets of fiscal year {code} by department and budget line, in baht

total.DEPT: Total of the departments you head

table.plannedLink: Planned {amount} baht of {code}: see the imports
table.availableLink: Available {amount} baht of {code}: see the ledger movements

empty.title: No budget in this fiscal year yet
empty.noYear: The organization has no fiscal year yet
empty.hintAdmin: Import the budget from an Excel file made from the template and the figures appear here.
empty.hintOther: Once the organization's budget administrator imports the budget, the figures appear here.

forbidden: The budget pages are for department heads, finance, budget administrators, executives and auditors. If your work needs the budget, ask your organization administrator.

export.title: Budgets, fiscal year {code}
export.note: Amounts in baht before VAT with two decimals · percentages of the planned amount

line.reservedIntro: Requests sent but not yet on a purchase order, and what a purchase order waiting for approval reserves above its requests
line.committedIntro: Approved purchase orders still waiting for their invoices
line.actualIntro: Invoices finance has confirmed, by purchase order
line.poExtra: Waiting for approval: reserves what it costs above the request
line.movementsIntro: Every time budget moves between available, reserved, committed and actual; the latest first
line.forbidden: This budget line belongs to a department you do not head. Department heads see the budgets of their own departments.

import.title: Import budgets from Excel
import.intro: Each row adds budget to one budget line: a new code makes a new line, a known code adds to it. Amounts are baht before VAT. If even one row is wrong, nothing is saved.
import.checkIntro: Download the template, fill it from row 3, then choose the file to check it. Checking saves nothing.
import.resultTitle: Check of {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
import.resultErrors: Fix {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} in the file and check it again. Nothing has been saved.
import.resultFileErrors: This file cannot be used. Fix what the message says and check it again. Nothing has been saved.
import.actionAdd: Adds to the existing budget line (now {current} baht)
import.summary: Imports {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}, {total} baht in all · new budget lines {creates} · added to existing lines {adds}
import.duplicate: This file was imported on {time} as {fileName}. Importing it again adds every row's amount once more.
import.duplicateBy: This file was imported on {time} as {fileName} by {name}. Importing it again adds every row's amount once more.
import.duplicateConfirm: I want to add the amounts of this file again
import.confirm: I confirm adding the budget listed above. The amounts are recorded in the budget ledger and cannot be removed.
import.submit: Import {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
import.imported: Imported {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}, {total} baht in all, with {created, plural, one {# new budget line} other {# new budget lines}}
import.historyEmpty: No budget has been imported yet. Start by downloading the template above.
import.historyRow: {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} · {total} baht in all · fiscal year {fiscalYear}
import.forbidden: Importing budgets is for budget administrators only. If you need to import budgets, ask your organization administrator for the budget administrator role.

reasons.TOO_LONG: Too long: codes up to 50 characters, names up to 200
reasons.INVALID_AMOUNT: Enter an amount above 0 with at most 2 decimals, such as 500000 or 1234.50
reasons.DUPLICATE_IN_FILE: The same budget line code as an earlier row in the same fiscal year: make it one row
reasons.UNKNOWN_FISCAL_YEAR: Unknown fiscal year: use a code from the guide sheet, such as FY2569
reasons.FISCAL_YEAR_CLOSED: This fiscal year is closed and takes no more budget
reasons.UNKNOWN_DEPARTMENT: Unknown department code: use a code from the guide sheet
reasons.UNKNOWN_COST_CENTER: Unknown or inactive cost center: use a code from the guide sheet
reasons.COST_CENTER_OF_ANOTHER_DEPARTMENT: This cost center belongs to another department: use one of this row's department
reasons.LINE_OF_ANOTHER_DEPARTMENT: This budget line code exists already for another department: use a new code
reasons.NO_ROWS: The file has no data rows yet: fill it from row 3
reasons.TOO_MANY_ROWS: The file has more than {max} data rows: split it into several files
reasons.UNREADABLE: This file cannot be opened: use an Excel file (.xlsx) made from the template
reasons.MISSING_HEADER: Row 1 must keep the template's column names: download the template again and fill it

errors.FILE_MISSING: Choose an Excel file before checking
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than {max} KB: split it into several files
errors.DUPLICATE_CONFIRM: Tick the box to confirm you want to add this file's amounts again
errors.RECHECK: The organization's data changed after the check. Nothing has been saved. Check the file again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your account cannot import budgets (budget administrators only)
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again and retry.
errors.BUSY: The system is busy with this budget. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.CONFLICT: This import was already sent with other data. Check the file again before importing.
errors.INTERNAL: The import failed because of a system error. Tell your administrator the reference {requestId}.
errors.FAILED: The import did not go through and nothing was saved. Try again.
errors.RECHECK_FILE: The file sent is not the one that was checked. Nothing has been saved. Check the file again before importing.

guide.line1: Fill the Budget sheet from row 3, one budget line per row. Do not change row 1 (the column names).
guide.line2: Amounts are baht before VAT with at most 2 decimals. A new budget line code makes a new line; a known code adds to it.
guide.line3: Use the fiscal year, department and cost center codes listed below; the cost center must belong to the row's department.
guide.line4: Every row is checked first: if one is wrong, nothing is saved. Importing the same file again must be confirmed before the amounts are added.
guide.fiscalYears: Fiscal year codes you can import to
guide.name: Name

warnings.nameTh: The name differs from the existing line ({current}); the amount is added under the existing name
warnings.accountCode: The account code differs from the existing line ({current}); the existing account code stays
warnings.costCenter: The cost center differs from the existing line ({current}); the line keeps its cost center
warnings.notice: {count, plural, one {# row differs} other {# rows differ}} from the existing budget line. The amount is added to the line as it is, without changing its name, account code or cost center. To make a new budget line, use a new code and check again.

grants.title: Cross-department budget use
grants.intro: Let another department, or one member, choose a budget line in their requests for a period. Requests on another department's budget go to the approvers of the department that owns it.
grants.formTitle: Grant use of a budget line
grants.kindDepartmentHint: Every member of that department can choose this budget line
grants.lastDayHint: The last day starts at the end of the chosen line's fiscal year; you can change it
grants.noLines: There is no budget line to grant yet. Import the budget first.
grants.currentEmpty: No cross-department grant is in force. Grant one with the form.
grants.pastEmpty: No grant has ended or been revoked yet
grants.revokeConfirm: Once revoked, new requests cannot choose this budget line. Requests already sent keep what they reserved. To allow it again, make a new grant.
grants.forbidden: Cross-department budget use is managed by budget administrators only. If you need to grant budget use, ask your organization administrator for the budget administrator role.

errors.OWN_DEPARTMENT: This department owns the budget line already: choose another department

detail.more: Showing {shown} of {count} documents, the largest first. The total below counts every document.
detail.plannedTitle: Imports making up the planned amount
detail.plannedIntro: Every import that added to the planned amount, the latest first
detail.plannedEmpty: Nothing has been imported yet. When the budget administrator imports a file, it shows here.

reservedEmpty.one: Nothing reserves this line. A request sent for approval reserves budget here until it is on a purchase order.
reservedEmpty.many: Nothing reserves these budgets. A request sent for approval reserves budget here until it is on a purchase order.

committedEmpty.one: No purchase order commits this line. When a purchase order is approved, its amount moves here from reserved.
committedEmpty.many: No purchase order commits these budgets. When a purchase order is approved, its amount moves here from reserved.

actualEmpty.one: No invoice has used this line yet. When finance confirms an invoice, its amount moves here from committed.
actualEmpty.many: No invoice has used these budgets yet. When finance confirms an invoice, its amount moves here from committed.

movementsEmpty.one: This budget line has no movements yet. Imports and every reservation, commitment and actual show here.
movementsEmpty.many: These budgets have no movements yet. Imports and every reservation, commitment and actual show here.
